facts.activity_file: insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: injury during a breakdown response on PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on PSV-8201 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 March 2017 an incident occurred on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
